evals.prompt: Write the test strategy and QA plan for monthly-invoice-generation in billing-api. All four inputs (prd.md, technical-breakdown.md, implementation-plan.md, project-plan.md) are under docs/ways-of-work/plan/usage-based-billing/monthly-invoice-generation/.
evals.expected_output: test-strategy.md, test-issues-checklist.md and qa-plan.md written next to the inputs, grounded in ISTQB techniques and ISO 25010 characteristics.
expectations: Three files are written under docs/ways-of-work/plan/usage-based-billing/monthly-invoice-generation/: test-strategy.md, test-issues-checklist.md and qa-plan.md
The test strategy names the ISTQB test design techniques selected for the feature
The test strategy rates each of the eight ISO 25010 quality characteristics
The QA plan defines entry and exit criteria for quality gates
Test issues carry test type labels such as unit-test, integration-test or e2e-test and a story point estimate
